title: Trending at Boots: Why the retailer is responding to beauty trends in real-time
summary: UK retailer major Boots is heavily invested in tracking real-time global trends to provide relevant beauty offerings – all within extremely short turnaround times – though curation remains key, say execs. Today, Boots keeps on top of trends via traditional data platforms and reports but also AI-led platforms that scan TikTok, Instagram, Google and even Reddit. “Tracking trends is the easy bit.
